key.connectLead: No account is connected. Paste your API key to connect this PC again.
key.hint: Tip for the key owner: the old key can be deleted at {{host}} › API keys.
key.saved: New API key saved. Connected as {{name}}.

signOut.text: Input folders are no longer watched. Images in the folders are not deleted. Image series that are still collecting are closed; their analyses and reports continue when you sign in to {{name}} again.
signOut.title: Sign out of {{name}}?

switch.text: This key belongs to {{next}}, not {{current}}. If you continue, the input folders of {{current}} are no longer watched. Their reports and history stay on this PC.
switch.title: Switch account?

page.denied: MiViA cannot save reports in this folder. Choose another report folder.
page.overlaps: This folder is inside another input folder, or contains one. Choose another folder.
page.title: Add input folder

autostart.help: Recommended, so no new image is missed. The app starts minimized in the tray.
autostart.label: Start MiViA Desktop with Windows

explorer.help: Right-click images in Explorer to analyze them one at a time.
explorer.label: Add “Analyze with MiViA” to the Explorer menu
explorer.unavailable: Available in the installed MiViA Desktop only.

done.autostartFailed: MiViA Desktop could not be set to start with Windows. Try again in Settings › General.
done.existing_one: The existing image is analyzed now.
done.existing_other: The {{count}} existing images are analyzed now.
done.explorerFailed: MiViA could not be added to the right-click menu. Try again in Settings › Explorer integration.
done.how: Save or copy images into {{folder}}. MiViA analyzes them and saves the report there.
done.legacyClose: Close the old MiViA Desktop. It is switched off at the next start of MiViA Desktop.
done.legacyFailed: The old MiViA Desktop could not be switched off. Close it and delete its folder.
done.legacyStartup: An administrator must remove this startup entry of the old MiViA Desktop: {{path}}
done.legacyStopped: The old MiViA Desktop is switched off. Its folder contains only program files, no reports; you can delete it.
done.perUser: Other Windows users on this PC set up MiViA Desktop for themselves.
done.reasonLicense: Your MiViA license is not active.
done.reasonNoModels: Your account has no models yet.
done.reasonOffline: MiViA cannot be reached at the moment.
done.single: Single images: right-click them in Explorer, choose “Show more options”, then “Analyze with MiViA”.
done.title: MiViA Desktop is ready
done.titleWaiting: MiViA Desktop is set up, but cannot analyze yet
done.tray: MiViA Desktop keeps running after you close this window. You find it in the Start menu and next to the clock (click ^ if you do not see the icon).
done.waitingSafe: New images wait in the folder and are analyzed as soon as this is solved.

finish.later: You can change all of this later in Settings.
finish.title: Windows and privacy

folder.existingLater: Images already in the folder are only analyzed if you choose that here.
folder.existingMany: This folder already contains more than {{count}} images.
folder.general: MiViA would analyze every image saved in this folder, including images that are not from the microscope. A separate folder is better.
folder.lead: Choose that folder. MiViA analyzes every new image that arrives there. Your images are never moved or deleted.
folder.legacyMissing: The input folder of the old MiViA Desktop ({{path}}) no longer exists. Choose a folder.
folder.mappedDrive: Drive {{letter}} is a network drive. MiViA uses its full address {{unc}}, so the folder is found even when the drive letter is missing.
folder.nested: This folder is inside the input folder {{name}}, or contains it. Choose another folder.
folder.network: This is a network folder. New images there are noticed a little later. If a colleague’s PC also watches this folder, each PC analyzes the images. Agree on one PC.
folder.notFound: MiViA cannot open this folder. Choose another folder.
folder.notSure: Not sure? Save one test image in the microscope program and look where it is saved. You can change the folder later.
folder.oneDrive: This folder is stored in OneDrive. Images and reports in it are copied to your organization’s OneDrive. Images that are only online are downloaded before they are analyzed. If a colleague’s PC also watches this folder, each PC analyzes the images.
folder.required: Choose a folder, or skip this step.
folder.skip: Skip: I only want to analyze single images from Explorer. You can add a folder later.
folder.title: Where does your microscope save images?
folder.tooBroad: Choose a folder only for microscope images, not a whole drive or a system folder.
folder.uploadCost: You have {{remaining}} image uploads left. This uses up to {{count}} of them.
folder.watchedElsewhere: This folder is already watched by MiViA Desktop on “{{machine}}” (“{{user}}”). Images would be analyzed twice and reports saved twice. Pause or remove it on the other PC first.

key.adminScope: This key has administrator rights. Create a key without administrator rights in MiViA and use that one.
key.autoRetry: MiViA tries again every 30 seconds. You can also close MiViA Desktop and continue later.
key.blocked: Your MiViA account is blocked. Contact MiViA support.
key.help: Ask the person who manages MiViA in your lab, or sign in at {{host}} and open API keys. A key starts with “mv-” and has 64 letters after it.
key.helpTitle: Where do I find my API key?
key.imported: The API key of the old MiViA Desktop was accepted.
key.importedInvalid: The API key of the old MiViA Desktop is no longer accepted. Enter a new one.
key.label: API key
key.lead: Paste or type your API key. It connects this PC to your MiViA account.
key.licenseInactive: Your MiViA license is not active. You can finish setup now; analysis starts as soon as the license is active.
key.malformed: This does not look like an API key. Copy the whole key again.
key.missingScopes: Create a key with all rights for images and jobs in MiViA and use that one.
key.offline: MiViA cannot be reached. Check the internet connection. If it works in the browser, ask your IT to allow {{host}}.
key.otherAccount: This key belongs to another account. The models you chose were reset.
key.rejected: This API key was not accepted. Check that you copied the whole key, or ask for a new one.
key.storeFailed: Windows could not store the API key. You will need to enter it again after restarting MiViA Desktop.
key.stored: The key is stored safely in Windows. For security, the copy in the clipboard was deleted.
key.storedOnly: The key is stored safely in Windows.
key.title: Connect to your MiViA account

legacy.found: The old MiViA Desktop is on this PC, in {{path}}. It has these settings:
legacy.notInFolder: No settings of the old MiViA Desktop were found in this folder. Choose the folder that contains “MiViA Desktop.exe”.
legacy.other: Not the right one? Choose the folder of the old MiViA Desktop
legacy.running: The old MiViA Desktop is still running.
legacy.safe: Your images and earlier reports stay where they are.
legacy.stop: Switch off the old MiViA Desktop (recommended, prevents images being analyzed twice). It is not deleted.
legacy.stopNetwork: The old MiViA Desktop is in a network folder. Other PCs may still use it, so it is not switched off.
legacy.title: Take over your old settings?
legacy.unreadable: The settings of the old MiViA Desktop could not be read. Enter your API key in the next step.

models.customizationHint: Settings saved for your lab on {{host}}
models.lead: Choose one or more. Each new image is analyzed with every model you choose, and each model gets its own report.
models.legacyCustomGone: The customization the old MiViA Desktop used for {{name}} is no longer available. Choose one.
models.legacyGone: {{name}} from the old MiViA Desktop is no longer available for your account. Ask the person responsible for MiViA in your lab or {{contact}}.
models.loadFailed: The list of models could not be loaded. Check the internet connection.
models.none: Your account has no models yet. Contact the person responsible for MiViA in your lab or {{contact}}. You can finish setup now; the folder starts working as soon as a model is available.
models.title: Which models should analyze the images?

quit.text: Until setup is finished, no images are analyzed, also not overnight. Your entries are kept. MiViA Desktop asks again the next time you sign in to Windows.
quit.title: Finish setup later?

resume.note: Setup is not finished yet. Your entries are kept.

series.byHandHint: The report is made 5 minutes after the last new image.
series.later: You can always create the report early with “Create report now”, and change the wait later in the folder settings.
series.lead: MiViA collects images that arrive together, for example the images of one sample, and saves one report for them per model.
series.longPath: This folder path is long, report names will be shortened.
series.microscope: The microscope software saves each image here
series.microscopeHint: The report is made 15 minutes after the last new image.
series.modeBeside: Next to the images (in the subfolder of each image series)
series.modeSubfolder: In the subfolder “{{name}}” of the input folder (recommended)
series.probeDenied: MiViA cannot save reports in {{folder}}. Reports go to {{fallback}} instead.
series.title: How do images arrive in this folder?
series.wholeFolder: I copy a whole folder per sample
series.wholeFolderHint: The report is made 1 minute after the folder is copied. Each subfolder gets its own report.

welcome.langAuto: Automatisch, wie Windows ({{language}}) / Automatic, like Windows ({{language}})
welcome.lead: MiViA Desktop analyzes your microscope images automatically. New images in a folder you choose are sent to MiViA, and the reports are saved on this PC.
welcome.legacyManual: I used the old MiViA Desktop before
welcome.need: Setup takes about 3 minutes. You need your MiViA API key, and this PC needs an internet connection.
welcome.noKey: No key yet? You can close MiViA Desktop and continue later. Nothing is lost.
welcome.title: Welcome to MiViA Desktop
